items.t: Musk Says Cybercab “Would Win Even at Price Parity.” That’s a Problem for Uber and Lyft
items.sum: Key TakeawaysElon Musk said Tesla’s Cybercab would win riders even at the same price as rivals, replying to a post about Dallas riders turning down discounts. If that holds, Uber and Lyft can’t win those riders back by matching fares, and their robotaxi partners Lucid and Mobileye face a car riders already prefer.

items.t: Anthropic Broke Its $83 IPO Price. What Did Facebook Do Next?
items.sum: Anthropic (ANT) closed at $82.79 on Wednesday, Nov 25. That is 0.3% below its $83 IPO price. It is also 14.8% below its $97.17 first close, only five trading days in. So what happened to other big listings that broke this fast.
